game_settings.title: Game Settings
game_settings.lite_mode_description: Optimize for longer battery life over peak performance
game_settings.dnd_mode_description: Block notifications and calls while gaming
game_settings.enabled_hint: Flux boosts this game while it is on screen

game_settings.lite_forced: Forced on by Enforce Lite Mode in Settings
game_settings.no_stats: No sessions recorded for this game yet. Play for at least 20 seconds to see FPS and temperatures here.

log_level_selection.title: Log Level
log_level_selection.brief: How much fluxd writes to its log. Changes apply immediately; the log is capped at about 4 MB.
log_level_selection.desc_1: Errors that break a tweak or a profile
log_level_selection.desc_3: Profile changes, games and warnings: best for daily use
log_level_selection.desc_4: Details of every decision: use when reporting a bug
log_level_selection.desc_5: Everything, very verbose: only when asked by the developer
log_level_selection.empty: Nothing logged at this level yet.
log_level_selection.viewer_note: Last 200 lines of flux.log, refreshed every 3 seconds.
log_level_selection.save_contents: Log, previous boot, settings, game sessions, device report and HiCo state, packed into Download.

trace_confirm.title: Enable Trace logging?
trace_confirm.message: Trace writes every decision fluxd makes. The log fills up quickly and uses a little more CPU. Use it only when asked for a bug report.

lite_mode.title: Lite Mode
lite_mode.brief: Lite mode reduces overheating and power consumption during gameplay by lowering CPU and component frequencies. This setting applies to all games when enabled.
lite_mode.state_on: On — every game runs cooler, on the lite profile
lite_mode.state_off: Off — Flux decides per game (Game settings)

cooler.title: Cooler device
cooler.description: CPU and GPU clocks stay lower, so the phone heats up more slowly in long sessions.

battery.title: Longer battery
battery.description: Less power per frame, so a charge lasts more matches.

performance.title: Lower peak performance
performance.description: Heavy scenes may drop a few more frames than on the full performance profile.

per_game.title: Overrides per-game choice
per_game.description: While on, it applies to every game, including ones without Lite mode in their settings.

confirm.title: Enforce Lite mode?
confirm.message: Every game will use the lite performance profile to stay cooler and save battery.
confirm.point_all_games: Applies to all games from the next launch
confirm.point_fps: Heavy games may run at a lower frame rate

lite_mode.saved_on: Lite mode on — applies from the next game launch
lite_mode.saved_off: Lite mode off — games use the full performance profile

disable_tweaks.title: Disable Tweaks
disable_tweaks.brief: When enabled, this setting turns off all built-in performance optimizations on Flux Tweaks, allowing you to use this module strictly as a host for Flux Addon modules.
disable_tweaks.state_on: On — Flux only hosts add-ons, no tweaks are applied
disable_tweaks.state_off: Off — all Flux tweaks are active

items.game_tweaks: Network, touch and refresh rate game tweaks
items.detection: Game detection and Do Not Disturb

confirm.title: Disable all tweaks?
confirm.message: Flux will stop tuning your device. Games will run on the stock kernel settings until you turn this off again.

disable_tweaks.reboot_note: A reboot is needed for this change so every tweak is fully reverted or applied again.
disable_tweaks.saved_reboot_later: Saved — reboot later to apply the change

device_mitigation.title: Device Mitigation
device_mitigation.brief: Device mitigation disables potentially incompatible tweaks for specific devices. Keep it disabled unless you have problems.
device_mitigation.state_on: Tweaks known to misbehave on some devices are skipped
device_mitigation.apply_note: Changes take effect the next time a profile is applied.

DISABLE_DDR_TWEAK.title: Keep memory bus stock
DISABLE_DDR_TWEAK.description: Skips raising the memory (DDR) bus and latency floors in the performance profile. Helps devices that stutter or reboot when these are changed.

NO_PERFORMANCE_CPUGOV.title: No performance governor
NO_PERFORMANCE_CPUGOV.description: Games keep the balanced CPU governor instead of "performance"; some kernels overheat or misbehave with it.

QCOM_NO_GPU_POWERSAVE.title: Keep GPU floor in Powersave
QCOM_NO_GPU_POWERSAVE.description: Snapdragon: Powersave no longer lowers the Adreno GPU minimum, which was reported to break video after waking the phone.

cpu_governor.title: CPU Governor
cpu_governor.default_description: Applied to balanced and performance profiles when lite mode is active
cpu_governor.powersave_description: Exclusively used for the powersave profile
cpu_governor.brief: CPU governor is an algorithm that dynamically adjusts the processor's frequency in real time, directly affecting system performance and power consumption.

modal.performance_warning: Setting the governor to "performance" will cause overheating and rapid battery drain. Are you sure you want to proceed?
modal.initial_warn: Please note that Flux Tweaks has automatically configured the optimal CPU Governor. Manual changes are not recommended unless you are an advanced user.

cpu_governor.notice: Governors marked with ⚠ cause heat and fast battery drain. Flux asks before applying them.
cpu_governor.none_found: This kernel does not list any CPU governors.
cpu_governor.apply_note: The change applies right away when that profile is active, otherwise on the next profile change.

confirm.point_heat: CPU stays at maximum clocks all the time
confirm.point_battery: Heat and battery drain rise sharply, even when idle
confirm.powersave_message: The powersave governor keeps the CPU at its lowest clocks. Daily use may feel slow and apps may stutter.

reboot_modal.title: Reboot Required
reboot_modal.description: This change requires a reboot to take effect. Would you like to reboot now?

toast.reboot_to_apply: Reboot your device to apply changes.
toast.shortcut_unavailable: No API available for this feature, use WebUI X to use this feature.

monitor_page.title: Live Monitor
monitor_page.thermal_unsupported: Thermal headroom API not available on this device (requires API 31+)
monitor_page.synthesis_outdated: SynthesisCore is outdated (protocol v{version}). Please reinstall the latest Flux module.

thermal_hint.hot: Thermal pressure high — Performance Lite engaged
thermal_hint.warm: Entering hysteresis zone — throttling may begin
thermal_hint.cool: All systems nominal — full performance unlocked

monitor_page.thermal_gki_note: GKI kernels may not expose thermal headroom API

flux_sched.title: Flux Sched
flux_sched.supported: Supported: this kernel exposes uclamp cgroups.
flux_sched.unsupported: Not supported: this kernel has no uclamp cgroups. Flux Sched has no effect here.
flux_sched.brief: While a game runs, Flux Sched raises the minimum CPU capacity of the foreground app and caps what background apps may request, so the game gets the fast cores first. This replaces the older schedtune boost, which modern (GKI) kernels no longer have. The stock values are saved and restored as soon as you leave the game.
flux_sched.apply_note: Changes take effect the next time a profile is applied, for example when a game starts.

flux_boost.title: Flux Boost
flux_boost.brief: Extra tuning on top of the performance profile, applied only while a game runs and fully restored when you leave it. Values are only raised, never lowered below what your device ships with.

vm.title: Memory headroom
vm.description: Reclaims memory earlier in the background and allows more pending writes, so loading assets causes fewer frame drops.

io.title: Storage latency
io.description: Completes storage requests on the CPU that asked for them (the game's), keeping them off busy little cores.

priority.title: Game priority
priority.description: Gives the game's worker threads higher CPU and storage priority than other apps. Threads Android already boosts are left alone.

flux_boost.apply_note: Changes take effect the next time a profile is applied, for example when a game starts.

sessions.fps_unavailable: This device exposes no frame-rate counter, so only play time and temperatures are recorded.
sessions.empty: Play a game from your list: each session appears here with play time, FPS and temperatures.
sessions.lite_hint: Flux lowered the profile because the device got hot (shaded in the charts)
sessions.not_found: This session is no longer in the history.

notify.save_failed: Couldn't save the setting. Check that root access is granted.

gpu_governor.title: GPU Governor
gpu_governor.brief: The GPU governor decides how fast the graphics processor runs. Games always use the kernel's own governor; this only changes the balanced and powersave profiles.
gpu_governor.balance_description: Used in the balanced profile, outside games
gpu_governor.powersave_description: Used only in the powersave profile
gpu_governor.unsupported_hint: This kernel does not expose a devfreq GPU governor (kgsl, Mali or g3d).
gpu_governor.apply_note: "Kernel default" keeps your kernel's governor. Changes apply right away when that profile is active.

confirm.performance_message: The GPU would stay at its highest clock outside games too.
confirm.point_heat: The device gets warm even on the home screen
confirm.slow_message: This governor can keep the GPU at a low clock, so animations and scrolling may stutter.

game_tweaks.title: Game Tweaks
game_tweaks.brief: Extra tweaks applied only while a game runs. Everything is put back when you leave the game.

net_tweaks.title: Network latency
net_tweaks.description: Low-latency TCP with BBR congestion control, ECN and Fast Open for steadier ping.

touch_tweaks.title: Touch response
touch_tweaks.description: Turns on the touch panel's game mode for faster, more direct touch input.
touch_tweaks.unsupported_note: This device has no /proc/touchpanel, so the touch tweak has no effect here.

game_refresh_rate.title: Max refresh rate in games
game_refresh_rate.description: Locks the display at its highest refresh rate while you play. Some ROMs may still override it.
game_refresh_rate.confirm_message: The screen stays at its maximum refresh rate while a game runs. Motion looks smoother but the battery drains faster. Your previous setting is restored after the game.

drop_caches.title: Clear memory cache
drop_caches.description: Frees cached memory when a game starts so it has more RAM to load into.

game_tweaks.apply_note: Changes apply the next time a game starts.
